summary: Unnamed Foundation Agent 001 is a Seeker working for the Huntik Foundation. He is a trained field operative and often works with two other unnamed agents, 002 and 003.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
This Foundation agent was present at Huntik Foundation Italian HQ when Klaus was released from King Basilisk's Stonegaze power. Later, he and Unnamed Foundation Agent 002 arrested Klaus and took him into Foundation custody. [The Blood Spiral]

This agent was sent to the Castle of Vlad Dracul with Agent 002 to try and subdue the wild Antedeluvian, but to no avail. Later, the pair's camp was ambushed by the Blood Spiral. The agent quickly summoned his Freelancer Titan, but they were both defeated and the agent knocked unconscious by a Nullcurse blast. Zhalia Moon then took the Spear of Vlad the Impaler from him, granting the Spiral access to the castle. [Lok's Leadership]

The agent and the field operatives arrested Rassimov outside the Tomb of Tutankhamun and drove him away to be taken into custody. However, their land rovers were later attacked by Harrison Fears and Jericho, freeing Rassimov and defeating the agents. [Rassimov's Secret]

This agent later travelled to the Spiral Mark with the rest of the Huntik Foundation and was seen fighting against the Silent Soldiers in the final battle. [Lok and the Betrayer] Following the defeat of the Betrayer, he and several other Foundation members were stationed at the Spiral Mark as they tried to make sense of the data. [Dante's Return]

sections.wikitext: Like most Foundation field operatives, this agent is trained in physical combat and can call on the standard Foundation powers and [[Titans]] such as [[Freelancer]].

This agent was sent to the Castle of Vlad Dracul with Agent 002 to try and subdue the wild Antedeluvian, but to no avail. Later, the pair's camp was ambushed by the Blood Spiral. The agent quickly summoned his Freelancer Titan, but they were both defeated and the agent knocked unconscious by a Nullcurse blast. Zhalia Moon then took the Spear of Vlad the Impaler from him, granting the Spiral access to the castle. [Lok's Leadership]

The agent and the field operatives arrested Rassimov outside the Tomb of Tutankhamun and drove him away to be taken into custody. However, their land rovers were later attacked by Harrison Fears and Jericho, freeing Rassimov and defeating the agents. [Rassimov's Secret]

This agent later travelled to the Spiral Mark with the rest of the Huntik Foundation and was seen fighting against the Silent Soldiers in the final battle. '''Unnamed Foundation Agent 001''' is a [[Seeker]] working for the [[Huntik Foundation]]. He is a trained field operative and often works with two other unnamed agents, [[Unnamed Foundation Agent 002|002]] and [[Unnamed Foundation Agent 003|003]]. 

== History ==
This Foundation agent was present at [[Huntik Foundation Italian HQ]] when [[Klaus]] was released from [[King Basilisk]]'s Stonegaze power. Later, he and [[Unnamed Foundation Agent 002]] arrested Klaus and took him into Foundation custody. {{source|The Blood Spiral}}

This agent was sent to the [[Castle of Vlad Dracul]] with Agent 002 to try and subdue the wild [[Antedeluvian]], but to no avail. Later, the pair's camp was ambushed by the [[Blood Spiral]]. The agent quickly summoned his [[Freelancer]] Titan, but they were both defeated and the agent knocked unconscious by a [[Nullcurse]] blast. [[Zhalia Moon]] then took the [[Spear of Vlad the Impaler]] from him, granting the Spiral access to the castle. {{source|Lok's Leadership}}

The agent and the field operatives arrested [[Rassimov]] outside the [[Tomb of Tutankhamun]] and drove him away to be taken into custody. However, their land rovers were later attacked by [[Harrison Fears]] and [[Jericho]], freeing Rassimov and defeating the agents. {{Source|Rassimov's Secret}}

This agent later travelled to the [[Spiral Mark]] with the rest of the [[Huntik Foundation]] and was seen fighting against the [[Silent Soldiers]] in the final battle. {{source|Lok and the Betrayer}} Following the defeat of [[the Betrayer]], he  and several other Foundation members were stationed at the Spiral Mark as they tried to make sense of the data. {{source|Dante's Return}}

== Abilities ==
Like most Foundation field operatives, this agent is trained in physical combat and can call on the standard Foundation powers and [[Titans]] such as [[Freelancer]].
